svg.text: AI CLUSTER SILENT DATA CORRUPTION (SDC), XID/ECC TRIAGE & 42S RESILIENT FAILOVER

2,048-GPU Cluster (MTBF = 8.8h): Tier 1 Manual Restart (68.4% Goodput, $1.42M Waste) vs. Tier 4 (98.1% Goodput, 0 SDC Poisonings)
⛔ Tier 1 Traps: The 8.8h MTBF Law & SDC Poisoning
1. Cluster MTBF Inverse Scaling (`MTBF_cluster = MTBF_gpu / N`):
• Even with a healthy `18,000-hour` single-GPU MTBF, a `2,048-GPU`
synchronous job suffers a hardware fault every `8.79 hours`!
2. Silent Data Corruption (`SDC`) Poisons All 2,048 GPUs:
• A single faulty TensorCore ALU bit-flip produces corrupted
gradients without an ECC alert—spreading `NaN` via `All-Reduce`!
3. Re-Scheduling onto Un-Cordoned `Xid 79 / 95` Bad Nodes:
• Restarting without auto-cordoning enters an infinite crash loop
Tier 1 Reactive Operations Failure Impact (2,048 GPUs):
• Effective Cluster Goodput: Only 68.4% (31.6% lost to stalls!)
• Mean Fault Recovery Time: 2,280s (38m) | SDC Poisonings: 3/mo
• Monthly Wasted Compute TCO: $1,420,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Pre-AllReduce SDC Gate & 42s P2P Failover
1. Pre-`All-Reduce` Local Gradient-Norm & Golden-Hash SDC Gate:
• Checks per-rank `||g_local||_2` before `All-Reduce` & runs a `15ms`
deterministic FP8/BF16 TensorCore Golden Hash during checkpoints!
2. Automated `Xid / SXid / ECC` Triage & Instant Cordon:
• `Xid 48/63/74/79/94/95` immediately taints the node, swaps in a
pre-validated `N+K` warm spare, and triggers background DCGM L3
3. 42s P2P In-Memory Checkpoint Broadcast (Zero Storage Read!):
• Healthy peers broadcast `16Ψ` shard state over RDMA in `42s`
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (2,048 GPUs):
